english_full_pretraining.note: Fluency needs data/compute far beyond these experiments.

english_v1.note: Sandbox experiment (357k params, tiny original corpus). Real run, val 4.44 -> 1.34. NOT fluency.

knowledge_v1.note: Sandbox experiment. Real run; val regressed 1.28 -> 1.34 (overfit tiny corpus).

supervised_v1.note: Contamination SUSPECTED in review (sampler indexed the full SFT list), INVESTIGATED and DISPROVEN: the sampler drew indices from range(len(train_lines))=9, and with the positional 80/10/10 split those indices can only select train-split examples (verified mathematically and by a bit-identical rerun with the corrected explicit sampler). Measurements stand. LIMITATION: the val/test splits contain a single example each, so the held-out SFT evaluation is statistically nearly empty; the earlier 'overfit' reading is not established either way. See runs/supervised_v1/INVESTIGATION.md.

ocr_v1.note: Sandbox experiment. From-scratch OCR, 1.000 char accuracy on held-out SYNTHETIC images only; not tested on photos.

supervised_v2.note: Rerun with the corrected explicit train-split sampler to verify the contamination suspicion: bit-identical losses to the original run, confirming no contamination occurred. Same run as supervised_v1; the explicit sampler is now the code path.

english_v2.note: Measured increment on public-domain corpus (394 KB, McGuffey readers + Aesop, provenance in study/data/provenance_v2.json). Fixed held-out eval: char loss 2.99 (english_v1) -> 1.94 (english_v2 @4500 steps, true resumes). NOT fluent — samples remain word-salad. See runs/english_v2/COMPARISON.md for the trajectory and the specific remaining training steps.
